sentences.en: Some ideas they had were Silk Digital which would sell downloadable products like stolen software and hacking software.
sentences.zh: 他们的想法之一是“丝绸数码”（Silk Digital），它将出售可下载的产品，如被盗软件和黑客软件。

sentences.en: Silk Pharma was another idea which would focus on prescription medication.
sentences.zh: “丝绸医药”（Silk Pharma）是另一个想法，将专注于处方药。

sentences.en: And last but not least, the armoury.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，军火库。

sentences.en: Guns had created problems on Silk
sentences.zh: 自枪支在丝绸

sentences.en: Road ever since they first appeared.
sentences.zh: 路上出现以来，它们就一直引发问题。

sentences.en: A large part of the community weren't happy that guns were for sale.
sentences.zh: 很大一部分社区对出售枪支感到不满。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book Silk Road by Eileen Ormsby, one user stated,
sentences.zh: 正如艾琳·奥姆斯比（Eileen Ormsby）所著的《丝绸之路》一书中所详述的那样，一位用户表示：

sentences.en: While I support the right of someone being able to have a single shotgun for self-defence,
sentences.zh: “虽然我支持人们拥有一把用于自卫的猎枪的权利，

sentences.en: I'm not comfortable with the idea of automatic and semi-automatic weapons being made available to anyone with the money to buy them.
sentences.zh: 但我对于让任何有钱购买的人都能买到自动和半自动武器这种想法感到不安。”

sentences.en: Just because we support the rights of people to put what they like in their own bodies doesn't mean that we are evil people, in spite of what the government would
sentences.zh: “仅仅因为我们支持人们在自己体内使用他们喜欢的东西的权利，并不意味着我们就是坏人，尽管政府

sentences.en: often have the general public believe.
sentences.zh: 常常让普通公众这样认为。”

sentences.en: A poll was created titled, Would you like to see the sale of guns removed from the Silk Road?
sentences.zh: 有人发起了一项民意调查，题为：“你希望看到枪支销售从丝绸之路上移除吗？”

sentences.en: The vote was split at around 50-50.
sentences.zh: 投票结果差不多是五五开。

sentences.en: Many users started adopting a signature under their posts that read, no guns on Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 许多用户开始在他们的帖子下方采用这样签名：“丝绸路上无枪”。

sentences.en: Even Tony 76, the former respected seller who had played the great 420 sales scam, stated that guns would be the downfall of Silk
sentences.zh: 甚至连托尼76（Tony 76）这位曾制造过盛大的420促销骗局、备受尊敬的前卖家也表示，枪支将是丝绸

sentences.en: Road.
sentences.zh: 路的灭亡之因。

sentences.en: He said it would bring unwanted attention from law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他说这会引来执法部门不必要的关注。

sentences.en: Author Nick Bilton outlines in the book American Kingpin that Variety Jones had tried to warn Ross that guns were not a good idea for business.
sentences.zh: 作家尼克·比尔顿（Nick Bilton）在《美国大亨》一书中指出，“杂货商琼斯”曾试图警告罗斯，枪支对生意来说不是个好主意。

sentences.en: At first, as was his nature, Variety Jones said it in a sarcastic and almost joking way.
sentences.zh: 起初，正如他的性格一样，“杂货商琼斯”以一种讽刺甚至可以说是开玩笑的方式说了出来。

sentences.en: The way he put it was that it was better to remove the guns so Grandma can come here for her cheap Canadian farmer meds and not trip over a Glock 9mm.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，最好把枪支拿掉，这样奶奶来这儿买她便宜的加拿大农夫药物时，就不会被一把格洛克9毫米手枪绊倒了。

sentences.en: Then Variety Jones became more direct with Ross and told him guns would scare off a lot of clients.
sentences.zh: 随后，“杂货商琼斯”对罗斯的态度变得更加直接，告诉他枪支会吓跑很多客户。

sentences.en: That's why they started discussing the possibility of opening up a separate site for guns, so the complaints from
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他们开始讨论为枪支开设一个独立网站的可能性，这样来自

sentences.en: Silk Road users would stop.
sentences.zh: 丝绸之路用户的投诉就会停止。

sentences.en: The first option they had in mind was to name the site Silk Armoury to continue on with the Silk brand, but Variety Jones said it didn't sound right, so they settled
sentences.zh: 他们脑海中的第一个选择是将该网站命名为“丝绸军械库”（Silk Armoury），以延续丝绸品牌，但“杂货商琼斯”说这听起来不对，于是他们决定

sentences.en: for the armoury.
sentences.zh: 就叫“军械库”（the armoury）。

sentences.en: Ross used code and programming from Silk Road to make the new website.
sentences.zh: 罗斯使用了丝绸之路的代码和编程来制作这个新网站。

sentences.en: He made a new logo, which was the letter A with wings.
sentences.zh: 他制作了一个新标志，是一带翅膀的字母A。

sentences.en: Once they launched the armoury, they realised that the implications of having a website for weapons were a lot more complicated than having a website for drugs.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们推出了军械库，他们就意识到，运营一个武器网站的复杂性要远远大于运营一个毒品网站。

sentences.en: With Silk Road, drugs could easily be shipped through the mail and sellers constantly thought of new ways to stay ahead so the drugs wouldn't be detected.
sentences.zh: 对于丝绸之路，毒品可以通过邮件轻松寄送，卖家不断想出新方法保持领先，以免毒品被检测出来。

sentences.en: But shipping guns was a different matter altogether.
sentences.zh: 但寄送枪支则是完全不同的另一回事。

sentences.en: It wasn't that easy to hide guns in the mail.
sentences.zh: 把枪支藏在邮件里可没那么容易。

sentences.en: Ross considered this and posted on his Facebook wall asking if anyone knew someone who worked in the shipping sector.
sentences.zh: 罗斯考虑到了这一点，并在他的Facebook主页上发帖询问是否有人认识在航运业工作的人。

sentences.en: One of his friends on Facebook asked why and Ross answered that he had a new startup idea.
sentences.zh: 他在Facebook上的一个朋友问为什么，罗斯回答说他有一个新的创业想法。

sentences.en: Ross and Variety Jones knew they were a target for law enforcement, but the reality was they had no idea if they were on anyone's radar or not at that point.
sentences.zh: 罗斯和“杂货商琼斯”都知道他们是执法部门的目标，但现实是，他们当时根本不知道自己是否在某个人的雷达上。

sentences.en: Just to be safe, Variety Jones decided he would head to Thailand, where he said he had hidden before and where he had dirty cops working for him.
sentences.zh: 为了安全起见，“杂货商琼斯”决定前往泰国，他说他以前在那里藏匿过，而且有腐败警察为他效力。

sentences.en: Ross decided to leave Austin too.
sentences.zh: 罗斯也决定离开奥斯汀。

sentences.en: He moved to San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 他搬到了旧金山。

sentences.en: He had been contemplating a move for a while, and coincidentally, a friend of his, Rene, asked him to move to San
sentences.zh: 他考虑搬家已经有一段时间了，巧合的是，他的一个朋友勒内（Rene）邀请他一起搬到旧金

sentences.en: Francisco with him.
sentences.zh: 山去。

sentences.en: Rene said they could work on building a start-up business together, and Ross could stay in the apartment with he and his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 勒内说他们可以一起努力建立一个初创企业，罗斯可以和他以及他的女朋友住在同一个公寓里。

sentences.en: Ross accepted.
sentences.zh: 罗斯接受了。

sentences.en: But before leaving, he had to have another discussion with his ex-girlfriend, Julia.
sentences.zh: 但在离开之前，他不得不与他的前女友茱莉亚（Julia）进行另一次交谈。

sentences.en: Ross had told his old programming friend, Richard, that he sold Silk Road and no longer had anything to do with it, but he hadn't had that discussion with Julia yet.
sentences.zh: 罗斯曾告诉他的老程序员朋友理查德（Richard），他已经把丝绸之路卖掉了，跟它再无关系，但他还没跟茱莉亚谈过这件事。

sentences.en: So Ross messaged Julia through Facebook and arranged a meeting.
sentences.zh: 于是罗斯通过Facebook给茱莉亚发了信息，并安排了一次会面。

sentences.en: Ross asked her if she'd told anyone else about the site apart from Erica.
sentences.zh: 罗斯问她除了埃丽卡（Erica）之外，是否还把这个网站的事告诉了其他人。

sentences.en: Julia apologised again for ever telling Erica to begin with and assured him that she hadn't told anyone else.
sentences.zh: 茱莉亚再次为一开始告诉了埃丽卡而道歉，并向他保证她没有告诉任何人。

sentences.en: Then Ross told her that he had given Silk Road away.
sentences.zh: 然后罗斯告诉她，他已经把丝绸之路转让出去了。

sentences.en: It had caused him too much stress and the only reason he'd kept it for so long was because he liked the power that came with it.
sentences.zh: 这给他带来了太多的压力，他保留了这么久的唯一原因是他喜欢随之而来的权力。

sentences.en: But now, he was finished.
sentences.zh: 但现在，他结束了。

sentences.en: Someone else was running it.
sentences.zh: 有别的人在运营它。

sentences.en: Julia believed his lie and thanked him for giving it up.
sentences.zh: 茱莉亚相信了他的谎言，并感谢他放弃了它。

sentences.en: Ross said they probably wouldn't be seeing each other again for a long time because he was leaving town.
sentences.zh: 罗斯说他们可能很长一段时间都不会再见面了，因为他要离开这个镇子。

sentences.en: And that was that.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: In the summer of 2012, Ross left for San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 2012年夏天，罗斯动身前往旧金山。

sentences.en: Almost as soon as Ross arrived in San Francisco, he had an altercation with Variety Jones.
sentences.zh: 几乎刚一到旧金山，罗斯就和“杂货商琼斯”发生了争执。

sentences.en: It wasn't their first altercation either.
sentences.zh: 这也不是他们第一次争吵了。

sentences.en: They previously had a disagreement over the great
sentences.zh: 他们之前曾就那次盛大的

sentences.en: 420 sale and giveaway.
sentences.zh: 420促销和赠品活动产生过分歧。

sentences.en: The person who won the prize had bought a lot of heroin and practically overdosed on it.
sentences.zh: 赢得奖品的那个人买了很多海洛因，差一点因吸食过量而丧命。

sentences.en: Variety Jones didn't think it was a good idea giving him the money for the prize as he was trying to get clean.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”认为把奖金给他并不是个好主意，因为他当时正试图戒毒。

sentences.en: But Ross laughed it off and said they should give away a prize to rehab for the next conteSt. They also had a disagreement over the selling of heroin itself.
sentences.zh: 但罗斯对此付诸一笑，并表示他们应该在下次比赛中把奖品送给康复中心。他们还就海洛因本身的销售问题产生了分歧。

sentences.en: Variety Jones hated heroin and he didn't want to profit off of it.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”讨厌海洛因，他不想从中获利。

sentences.en: But Ross saw things differently, believing it wasn't up to him to stop someone from doing what they wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 但罗斯看法不同，他认为阻止别人做他们想做的事并不由他决定。

sentences.en: But their latest argument was a more significant one.
sentences.zh: 但他们最近的这场争吵更为重大。

sentences.en: Variety Jones wanted co-ownership of Silk Road.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”想要丝绸之路的共同所有权。

sentences.en: He said they could do things one of two ways.
sentences.zh: 他说他们可以通过两种方式之一来解决。

sentences.en: Either they went 50-50, or Variety Jones would take Silk Road for himself.
sentences.zh: 要么他们五五分成，要么“杂货商琼斯”将丝绸之路据为己有。

sentences.en: Ross couldn't believe what he was hearing.
sentences.zh: 罗斯简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

sentences.en: He told Variety Jones to bring it on if he wanted, because he wasn't going to give in to his demands.
sentences.zh: 他告诉“杂货商琼斯”如果想来就尽管来，因为他是不会屈服于他的要求的。

sentences.en: Variety Jones was already making $60,000 a month for his services, and that's where Ross was leaving it.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”提供服务已经能每月赚取6万美元，罗斯也就打算就此打住。

sentences.en: He wasn't giving away equity.
sentences.zh: 他不会让出股权。

sentences.en: After some heated discussion, Variety Jones accepted
sentences.zh: 经过一番激烈的讨论，“杂货商琼斯”接受了

sentences.en: Ross's decision and didn't try and make a play to take over Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 罗斯的决定，并没有试图采取行动接管丝绸之路。

sentences.en: Their discussions then moved on to another topic.
sentences.zh: 他们的讨论随后转向了另一个话题。

sentences.en: Security.
sentences.zh: 安全。

sentences.en: They were both well aware the authorities might be watching their every move.
sentences.zh: 他们都非常清楚当局可能在监视他们的一举一动。

sentences.en: At that point in time, they hadn't come face to face with anyone suspicious, but they wanted to be ready in case they ever did.
sentences.zh: 在那时，他们还没有遇到任何可疑的人，但他们希望做好准备，以防万一。

sentences.en: Already, some months prior, Ross implemented secret questions with each of his employees.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，罗斯就已经与他的每个员工实施了秘密问题机制。

sentences.en: Ross gave each employee a question and a specific answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 罗斯给每个员工一个问题和对该问题的特定答案。

sentences.en: The only people who knew the question and the answer were Ross and his employee.
sentences.zh: 知道问题和答案的只有罗斯和他的员工。

sentences.en: If Ross got the wrong answer to his question, he would immediately shut down the account of the employee.
sentences.zh: 如果罗斯收到的问题答案不对，他就会立即关闭该员工的账户。

sentences.en: Ross then adopted another condition for his employees.
sentences.zh: 接着，罗斯对他的员工采纳了另一项条件。

sentences.en: If someone wanted to work for him, he or she would have to provide some sort of ID.
sentences.zh: 如果有人想为他工作，他或她必须提供某种身份证件。

sentences.en: This could be a driver's license or a passport.
sentences.zh: 这可以是驾照或护照。

sentences.en: It wasn't just about wanting to know who worked for him, it was also a guarantee for himself.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是出于想知道谁为他工作的目的，也是他对自己的一种保障。

sentences.en: His employees were starting to handle more and more responsibilities, and some even had access to Bitcoin accounts.
sentences.zh: 他的员工开始承担越来越多的责任，有些人甚至可以访问比特币账户。

sentences.en: So now, if someone decided to steal from him, he would have their name and address.
sentences.zh: 因此，现在如果有人决定偷他的东西，他就会掌握他们的姓名和住址。

sentences.en: He made it clear to his employees that was the purpose of providing the ID and that he wasn't someone to mess with.
sentences.zh: 他向员工明确表示，这就是提供身份证件的目的，而且他不是一个好惹的人。

sentences.en: Along with these new employment conditions, Ross took care of security on his laptop.
sentences.zh: 除了这些新的雇佣条件外，罗斯还照顾好了他笔记本电脑上的安全。

sentences.en: Earlier that year, he'd bought a Samsung laptop.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，他买了一台三星笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: The problem was, he hadn't encrypted it at all.
sentences.zh: 问题是，他根本没有对其进行加密。

sentences.en: Variety Jones had recently discussed a case on the news.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”最近讨论了新闻中的一个案件。

sentences.en: A man who was leaking information to WikiLeaks had been arrested and his computer was very easily accessed by the
sentences.zh: 一名向“维基解密”泄露信息的男子被捕，他的电脑非常容易被

sentences.en: FBI because he used the same password to log into his computer and for the encryption.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局（FBI）访问，因为他登录电脑和加密使用的是同一个密码。

sentences.en: Ross and
sentences.zh: 罗斯和

sentences.en: Variety Jones both agreed this was very stupid.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”都认为这非常愚蠢。

sentences.en: If he had used different passwords that were both strong, the FBI might not have been able to get into his computer so easily, if at all.
sentences.zh: 如果他使用的是不同的、且都很强的密码，FBI可能就不会那么容易侵入他的电脑了，甚至根本无法侵入。

sentences.en: Ross was adamant that he wouldn't make the same mistake.
sentences.zh: 罗斯坚决表示他不会犯同样的错误。

sentences.en: Variety Jones told him to set his laptop to do two things.
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”告诉他将笔记本电脑设置为做两件事。

sentences.en: One was to shut down automatically if it hadn't been used for a certain amount of time and second was to install a kill switch.
sentences.zh: 一件是如果在一定时间内未使用则自动关机，第二件是安装一个紧急中止开关（kill switch）。

sentences.en: A kill switch automatically shuts down the computer with the press of a predetermined key on the keyboard.
sentences.zh: 紧急中止开关只需按下键盘上的预定按键即可自动关闭电脑。

sentences.en: Variety Jones explained that this was essential because if the FBI came after him and approached him in public, catching him off guard, he would
sentences.zh: “杂货商琼斯”解释说这至关重要，因为如果FBI来追捕他并在公共场合接近他、让他措手不及，他

sentences.en: just need to press one key on his laptop and it would shut down.
sentences.zh: 只需在笔记本电脑上按一个键，电脑就会关机。

sentences.en: And if he did his encryption right, the FBI would never be able to access his computer because they wouldn't have his passwords.
sentences.zh: 如果他正确进行了加密，FBI将永远无法访问他的电脑，因为他们没有他的密码。

sentences.en: Therefore, they would have no proof against Ross.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们将无法掌握针对罗斯的证据。

sentences.en: Ross did as Variety Jones told him and made those two changes on his laptop.
sentences.zh: 罗斯照着“杂货商琼斯”的话做了，在笔记本电脑上做了这两处更改。

sentences.en: Ross asked if he should store all of the Silk Road files on the cloud, that way they wouldn't be on his computer at all.
sentences.zh: 罗斯询问是否应该将所有丝绸之路的文件存储在云端，这样它们就根本不会留在他的电脑上了。

sentences.en: But that would make working on the site a lot slower, so Variety Jones instructed Ross to keep the files on his computer, but to make sure he encrypted every single one of them.
sentences.zh: 但这会使在网站上工作变得慢得多，因此“杂货商琼斯”指示罗斯将文件保存在电脑上，但务必确保对每一份文件进行加密。
